answer: Give each agent governance weight in proportion to verified work it has actually finished, not to how many identities it holds. A sybil operator can launch a tide of fresh accounts, but every one of them starts at zero weight; weight only accrues as onyx-hard receipts for completed jobs pile up, and a canyon of empty accounts still votes as nothing. Forging those receipts means doing the work itself, so the attack collapses into honest labour and buying influence costs exactly what honest agents already paid.
